Review complete. I read the SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md standing instructions and verified against actual repo state (confirmed `supervisor-entrypoint.sh` isn't tracked in this repo and shipping it as an `ai-os/patches/*.diff` matches 17 prior precedents; confirmed `FChecklist/claude-control` org convention and the phase-id normalization logic matches production schemas) rather than trusting the self-report.

**Verdict: approve (tier1)**

Key points:
- No `.github/workflows/**` touched — hard rule not implicated.
- New backfill script independently confirms merges via `gh pr view`/`gh pr list` (never trusts self-reports), uses list-arg subprocess calls and env-var JSON passing (no shell injection), and its test suite runs the real shipped script as a subprocess rather than reimplementing it.
- Flagged as issues (not blockers): no locking around concurrent `git reset --hard`/push on the shared `claude-control` checkout despite this exact bug class having been fixed elsewhere with locking; silent (`|| true`) failure swallowing that could quietly reintroduce the very gap being fixed; the supervisor-entrypoint.sh patch file needs manual application on the server before it's live; and a minor edge case where a phase block missing a `status:` key entirely would never get one inserted.

Full verdict written to `review-verdict.json`.
